candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call sees all six common inputs and emits one immutable, provenance-visible analysis state coupling contractual obligations with interacting behavioral objectives. The final call consumes that state first and retains common-source visibility, but the committed state cannot be reopened, ranked, rolled back, pruned, or replaced; it is materialized once into one policy.
candidate_structure.name: Constructive Obligation Typestate Relay
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential relay with upstream commitment authority and downstream materialization authority

calls.objective: Identify contractual evidence and cross-objective interactions before any policy artifact exists, then commit one positive, internally coherent obligation state with visible provenance. Exclude local anchor edits, reversible deltas, alternatives, rankings, and postconstruction pruning.

Consume the immediately preceding committed obligation state as the controlling evidence and perform its single permitted state transition into one complete contract-compliant policy. Do not reopen commitments, repair the anchor locally, create rollback states, select among alternatives, or apply terminal compression.

mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: constructive obligation coupling in an immutable pre-materialization typestate followed by one forward-only materialization
rejected_assumptions: Behavioral quality must emerge from anchor-local checkpoint-patch repairs.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace the mutable repair stack with one immutable constructive-obligation typestate edge that resolves cross-objective interactions before policy materialization.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: A globally coupled commitment should change object-hit and byte-hit prioritization together while also changing scan-resistance and phase-shift responses, without dependence on edit order or terminal pruning.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The incumbent family binds behavioral commitments to anchor-local repairs and evaluates cross-objective interactions only after those commitments have accumulated.

structural_mutation.after: An obligation architect commits one positive, provenance-visible cross-objective typestate before any artifact exists; a succeeding materializer performs the sole forward transition from that state to one policy.
structural_mutation.before: One producer mutates an anchor-derived reversible delta stack and compresses that stack after construction.
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation replaces the single-node repair loop with a typed inter-call edge whose upstream endpoint owns behavioral commitment and whose downstream endpoint owns only forward materialization, changing edge authority, evidence timing, and state-transition semantics.
